summary: Phase 4 (Gestão de Subscrição) end-to-end validated. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass covering GET /api/subscription (auth-gated, admin premium shape with plans+subscription+has_billing, free-user shape), POST /api/payments/portal (admin -> billing.stripe.com URL, free-user -> 400), POST /api/payments/cancel-subscription (admin -> cancel_at_period_end=true persisted + is_premium stays True, free-user -> 400). Frontend: full UI flow verified — admin sees sub-active with 'Premium Mensal' + status 'Ativa', clicks portal-btn -> redirects to https://billing.stripe.com/p/session/..., clicks cancel-btn -> status becomes 'Cancela no fim do período', cancel-btn hidden, toast shown, sidebar shows 'Subscrição Premium / GERIR'. Free user sees sub-free with upgrade-btn -> navigates to /planos; sidebar shows 'Plano Grátis / Upgrade'. All 7 data-testids present and functional (nav-subscricao, sub-active, sub-status, portal-btn, cancel-btn, sub-free, upgrade-btn). Admin's Stripe subscription was restored (cancel_at_period_end=false) after tests; is_premium and stripe ids intact.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/subscription correctly handles the new Stripe API shape where current_period_end lives on the subscription item (fallback item.current_period_end when top-level is missing). Confirmed via live admin subscription retrieve.

_get_portal_config lazily creates a default billing portal Configuration when none exists on the Stripe account — good self-healing. Configuration includes subscription_cancel with mode='at_period_end', matching product intent.

cancel-subscription only sets cancel_at_period_end=True (does NOT delete). is_premium remains True until Stripe webhook customer.subscription.deleted fires at period end — verified in test_admin_cancel_sets_cancel_at_period_end. Webhook handler (server.py:1002-1006) correctly flips is_premium=false on 'deleted' or on 'updated' with status in {canceled, unpaid, incomplete_expired}.
_activate_premium persists stripe_customer_id + stripe_subscription_id, enabling has_billing and cancel-subscription later. Verified admin doc has both fields.

has_billing is derived from stripe_customer_id (bool coercion), so users who paid but whose subscription was already deleted still see the portal button — intentional and correct so they can view invoices.
Subscription.jsx uses window.location.href for portal redirect (correct for Stripe portal); cancel path calls loadSubscription() before showing toast, so UI is consistent.

Minor duplication: dashboard/subscription NAV entry logic in AppLayout.jsx uses inline conditionals for label + testid; extracting a small SidebarSubscriptionLink helper would reduce noise but not required.
server.py is now ~1050 lines with subscription block ~150 lines — continues to warrant modularization (auth, payments, ai, etc.), still not urgent.
